senses.gloss:
जठर जठर,
 I. adj., f. रा.
 1. Hard, Śāntiś. 4, 13.
 2. Old, Śiś. 4, 29(?).
 II. m.
 1. The belly, Pañc. i. d. 27.
 2. The womb, Bhāg. P. 3, 33, 4.
 3. The interior, Rām. 3, 41, 26.
 --Cf. probably Lat. venter; γαστήρ; Goth. qvithra and in-kiltho.

जाठर जाठर, i. e. जठर + अ,
 I. adj., f. री,
 1. Of the belly, Mārk. P. 2, 37.
 2. With अग्नि,
 a. The digestive power, Suśr. 1, 128, 18.
 b. Hunger, Pañc. ii. d. 193.
 II. m. A child, Bhāg. P. 3, 14, 38.
